output.question: Where can I find Coca-Cola's latest annual report?
output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, The Coca-Cola Company’s latest annual report is its 2025 Form 10-K, filed February 20, 2026, covering the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Find it on the company’s Investor Relations website under Filings & Reports → Annual Filings (10-K), or use the direct report URL in the sources below. The report page also offers a “Complete Filing PDF” download.
